evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it with the aliases “AVIC Radio Electronics Research Institute” and “AVIC 615”. AVIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says its businesses include aviation weapons and equipment and military transport aircraft. The US Commerce Department listed it in March 2025 for acquiring or attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization, citing ties to activities including hypersonic weapons development.
It belongs to AVIC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise managed by the central government.
